{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs/task-90b32f96.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = grid[0][0]
    # Separator color forms full horizontal and vertical dividers.
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    markers = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (sep, grid[0][0])}
    # In these puzzles, the background is the most common non-divider color;
    # the single rare color marks dots within each compartment.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(v for v in counts if v != background)
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(row_bounds, row_bounds[1:]):
        row = []
        for ca, cb in zip(col_bounds, col_bounds[1:]):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == marker
                    for r in range(ra + 1, rb)
                    for c in range(ca + 1, cb))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
